ActualValues.description: Measured quarter-hour means in EMHASS's signs (W), SOC 0–1.
ActualValues.title: ActualValues

decide_offset_s.description: Normally the decision follows the publish; this is the fallback.
decide_offset_s.title: EMHASS mode fallback at (seconds into each quarter)

drift_check.description: Live mode: when the charger shows another current limit than EMHASS Lens set and nothing new was decided (the car's or the charger's app, an OCPP backend), set it back. Not within 90 s after EMHASS Lens's own write, only when seen twice in a row, and after 3 corrections within an hour it stops for an hour and Health says something else keeps changing it.
drift_check.title: Set back a current limit something else changed

mode.description: Dry run: decide like the automation and compare with what it did, without touching the charger. Live: EMHASS Lens drives the charger itself (turn the automation off first).
mode.title: EV charger control

tick_offset_s.description: Excess Solar and the SoC stop are evaluated every minute; 55 s is just before the automation's own minute tick, so dry-run comparisons read what it did.
tick_offset_s.title: Check every minute at (seconds)

automation.description: Live mode refuses to act while this automation is on, so the two never both drive the charger.
automation.title: Home Assistant automation (interlock)

charge_mode_select.description: Your helper with the options Manual, EMHASS and Excess Solar.
charge_mode_select.title: Charge mode select

charging_state_sensor.description: 0 unplugged, 1/2/5 plugged in or paused, 4 charging.
charging_state_sensor.title: Charging state (raw)

deferrable_sensor.description: What publish-data writes for the EV. The stored plan is used when it isn't updated yet.
deferrable_sensor.title: EMHASS's EV power sensor

pv_potential_sensor.description: Used instead of the measured PV when it is much higher (the inverter is curtailing).
pv_potential_sensor.title: Potential PV power

target_soc_number.description: Charging stops when the car has been at or above this for a while; it is then set back to 100.
target_soc_number.title: Target SoC

compare_delay_s.description: Dry run: how long after a decision to start reading what the automation did.
compare_delay_s.title: Compare with the automation after

max_current_a.description: A safety cap on what EMHASS Lens writes to the charger.
max_current_a.title: Never set more than

pv_potential_gap_w.title: Use the potential PV above this gap

pv_stale_s.description: Excess Solar never raises the current on PV data older than this.
pv_stale_s.title: PV data counts as stale after

soc_compare_window_s.title: Comparison window for the SoC stop

CostfunTotals.description: Energy and money over a plan's horizon, computed the same way for every cost function.
CostfunTotals.title: CostfunTotals

deadline_timesteps_entity.description: Number of 15-minute steps from now by which the load must be done; 0 = no deadline.
deadline_timesteps_entity.title: Deadline (time steps from now) from

running_entity.description: Optional: an entity that says the load runs right now, e.g. the charger's state sensor. EMHASS (0.18.2+) then plans a load that is already on as on, instead of scheduling a fresh start. Leave empty to send nothing.
running_entity.title: Running now when

running_states.description: The states of that entity that mean running, e.g. on, charging or 4.
running_states.title: Running states

single_constant_entity.title: Run in one block when on

DriftStatus.description: The minute check that sets back what something else changed.
DriftStatus.title: DriftStatus

base_url.description: Base URL of the EMHASS App, e.g. http://5b918bf2-emhass:5000. Leave empty to look it up through the Supervisor.
base_url.title: EMHASS address

extra_runtime_params.description: Added to every MPC payload as-is (shown in each run's Explain view).
extra_runtime_params.title: Extra runtime parameters

mode.description: Off: never calls EMHASS actions. Dry run: builds and checks every payload but does not send it. Live: runs and publishes.
mode.title: Mode

auto_fit.description: Retrains EMHASS's load model right after the first MPC run in the night window, so it keeps up with the house. Only while EMHASS Lens drives EMHASS (live, Auto MPC on); never tunes. MPC runs wait while EMHASS fits, so a slow fit can cost one quarter's run.
auto_fit.title: Fit the model automatically

auto_fit_hour.description: The fit follows the first MPC run from this hour on; the window lasts 3 hours.
auto_fit_hour.title: Night window starts at

fit_on_fault.description: When the model forecasts fewer slots than the horizon (a tuned model) or the lag count changed, fit right after the next MPC run instead of waiting for the night. At most once every 6 hours.
fit_on_fault.title: Fit right away when the model can't serve the runs

num_lags.description: Leave empty to derive it like before: 192 + 96 × forecast extension days.
num_lags.title: Lags

var_model.description: The household power sensor (without deferrable loads) EMHASS learns from.
var_model.title: Load sensor for the ML model

auto.description: Run naive-mpc-optim every quarter-hour. Only acts when the mode is dry run or live.
auto.title: Run MPC automatically

compare_costfuns.description: Before each live plan, also run the other two cost functions with the same inputs, so the Plan page can show what each would do and cost. Two extra optimisations per quarter-hour (each a few seconds to a minute, EMHASS's latest plan is only final once all three are done), so move the MPC time earlier if publishing gets tight. 'Compare now' on the Plan page does the same once.
compare_costfuns.title: Compare cost functions on every run

costfun.description: What EMHASS optimises for. Profit: import cost minus export revenue (EMHASS's usual default). Cost: import cost only, exports earn nothing. Self-consumption: use as much PV on site as possible. 'EMHASS's own setting' sends nothing and leaves EMHASS's configured costfun in charge. Needs EMHASS 0.18 or newer; the plan read back shows which one EMHASS used, and Health warns if it was ignored.
costfun.title: Cost function

hazard_guard_s.description: Older EMHASS versions (< 0.18.2) can fail when a run starts within this many seconds of a slot rounding boundary; the run waits it out.
hazard_guard_s.title: Grid-boundary guard

max_horizon.description: Cap the number of slots sent to EMHASS.
max_horizon.title: Maximum horizon

min_horizon.description: Refuse to run when fewer future slots than this have prices.
min_horizon.title: Minimum horizon

slot_offset_s.description: 780 = mm:13:00, two minutes before the next quarter starts, so the plan for the next slot is ready before it is published.
slot_offset_s.title: Run at (seconds into each quarter)

enabled.description: Call publish-data right after each quarter starts (live mode), so EMHASS's sensor.p_* entities show the slot that just began.
enabled.title: Publish each quarter

on_unavailable.description: Refuse: skip the run and raise a problem. Default: use the value below.
on_unavailable.title: When unavailable

scale.description: 0.01 turns a percentage into the 0–1 EMHASS expects.
scale.title: Multiply by

EvReserveOut.description: PV kept out of the forecast sent to EMHASS because the EV takes it from excess solar.
EvReserveOut.title: EvReserveOut

busy_values.title: Busy when the state is one of

enabled.description: While the entity below shows one of the busy values (e.g. a Qilowatt mFRR session), MPC runs are built but not sent, the plan isn't published and the inverter isn't touched. When the session ends, the plan is re-applied right away.
enabled.title: Hold while a market session owns the inverter

handback_wait_s.description: After the session ends, how long to wait for the inverter control's enable switch to come back on before giving up.
handback_wait_s.title: Wait for the inverter hand-back

replan.description: Off: the existing plan is re-applied, with at most one inverter write. On: MPC also runs again with the battery state after the session; the inverter follows that plan from the next slot.
replan.title: Re-run MPC after a session

vat_included_pct.description: Removed before Estonian tariffs are applied. 0 if the values exclude VAT.
vat_included_pct.title: VAT included in the values

source.description: Extends the price horizon beyond the published day-ahead prices.
source.title: Price forecast

tomorrow_error_after.title: Error if tomorrow's prices are missing after

tomorrow_warn_after.title: Warn if tomorrow's prices are missing after

HoldStatus.description: A market session (e.g. Qilowatt mFRR) owning the inverter: MPC sends, publishes and inverter writes wait.
HoldStatus.title: HoldStatus

soc_final.title: Battery state of charge at the end of the horizon

decide_offset_s.description: Right after the plan is published (:02).
decide_offset_s.title: Decide at (seconds into each quarter)

drift_check.description: Live mode: every minute, compare the inverter's passive-mode settings and feed-in limit with what EMHASS Lens set for this slot, and set back what something else changed. Not within 2 minutes after EMHASS Lens's own write, only when the difference is seen twice in a row, and after 3 corrections of the same setting within an hour it stops for an hour and Health says something else keeps changing it.
drift_check.title: Check every minute and set back what drifted

mode.description: Dry run: decide each slot and compare with what the automation did, without touching the inverter. Live: EMHASS Lens sets the inverter itself (turn the automation off first).
mode.title: Inverter control

charger_mode_select.description: Control only acts while this is in passive mode.
charger_mode_select.title: Charger mode select

enable_boolean.description: The same switch the automation uses (mFRR sessions turn it off).
enable_boolean.title: Enabled when on

force_charge_grid_cap_above_w.title: Force charge: use the import max above

low_export_price.description: Feed-in 0 W and no PV-export mode when the slot's export price is at or below this (an unknown price counts as 0).
low_export_price.title: Block export at or below this price

component_levels.description: e.g. {"emhass": "debug"} for more detail from one part only.
component_levels.title: Per-component levels

level.description: Default follows the log_level option in the App's Configuration tab.
level.title: Log level

mode.description: Shadow: decides on every command change and every minute and compares with what the Home Assistant automation did. Live: EMHASS Lens runs the sessions itself (disable the automation first).
mode.title: Qilowatt market control

reconcile_offset_s.description: 15 s after the automation's own minute tick, so shadow comparisons read what it did.
reconcile_offset_s.title: Reconcile every minute at (seconds)

ha_automation.description: Live mode refuses to act while this automation is on, so the two never both drive the inverter.
ha_automation.title: Home Assistant automation (interlock)

session_select.description: Mirrored in live mode (none / buy / sell) for dashboards and the Home Assistant automation kept as a fallback; followed in shadow mode.
session_select.title: Session state select

source_sensor.description: Who sends the command: kratt or fusebox (through Qilowatt).
source_sensor.title: Market source

big_change_w.title: Bypass the cooldown for changes of

deadband_pct.title: Deadband as a share of the target

enter_w.title: Start or flip a session at

settle_s.description: How long to wait after a command changes, so a burst of three sensor updates lands first.
settle_s.title: Settle time

unavailable_timeout_s.title: End a session when the source is lost for

entity.description: A sensor in watts (W); a kW sensor works with Multiply by 1000. Leave empty to skip this quantity.
entity.title: Entity

invert.description: Tick when the sensor's sign is the reverse of EMHASS's (see the quantity's title).
invert.title: Opposite sign

scale.description: Brings the sensor to EMHASS's units: 1 for W, 1000 for kW; for the state of charge 0.01 turns % into the 0–1 EMHASS uses.
scale.title: Multiply by

backfill_days.description: How far back to read from Home Assistant's recorder on start and after a change here. The recorder keeps 10 days by default.
backfill_days.title: Read history back

battery.description: The battery's power in watts; for a sensor that counts charging as positive, tick Opposite sign.
battery.title: Battery power, W (+ discharge, − charge, like EMHASS's P_batt)

grid.description: The power at the grid connection in watts. Many meters count export as positive: tick Opposite sign then.
grid.title: Grid power, W (+ import, − export, like EMHASS's P_grid)

load.description: The household consumption in watts without the deferrable loads (the EV charger), usually the same sensor EMHASS learns from.
load.title: House load without deferrable loads, W (what EMHASS forecasts as P_Load)

pv.description: The PV production in watts, always positive.
pv.title: PV power, W

soc.description: The battery's state of charge; a sensor in % needs Multiply by 0.01 (the default here), a sensor that already reports 0–1 needs 1.
soc.title: Battery state of charge, %

host.description: Leave empty to use the Mosquitto broker App (credentials come from the Supervisor).
host.title: Broker host

day_peak.description: Working days 09–12 and 16–20, November–March. Empty = no peak rate.
day_peak.title: Day peak

holiday_peak.description: Weekends and holidays 16–20, November–March. Empty = no peak rate.
holiday_peak.title: Weekend peak

clock_basis.description: Local: the window follows the wall clock. Standard time: it is defined in winter time, so in summer it shifts one hour later (e.g. 23–08).
clock_basis.title: Clock

publish_time.description: Local time from which tomorrow's prices are polled.
publish_time.title: Day-ahead results expected at

mobile_service.description: e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone (Developer tools → Actions). Empty: no phone messages. Used by the EV charger control.
mobile_service.title: Mobile notify service

persistent.description: Raise a persistent notification for problems that last longer than the grace time.
persistent.title: Home Assistant notifications

fire_event.description: emhass_lens_plan_published, with the current slot's plan values in the event data.
fire_event.title: Fire an event after each publish

mqtt_enabled.description: Publish the EMHASS Lens device (prices, problem, last MPC, Auto MPC switch, Run MPC button) through MQTT discovery. Needs the Mosquitto broker App.
mqtt_enabled.title: MQTT entities

enabled.description: While the old integration still runs, compare its prices and MPC payload with ours.
enabled.title: Compare with the HACS integration

PlannedValues.description: What the plan in force said for a past slot (EMHASS's columns and signs).
PlannedValues.title: PlannedValues

export_entity.description: Same shape, for the export price. Leave empty to skip.
export_entity.title: Export price sensor

import_entity.description: A Home Assistant sensor whose raw_today / raw_tomorrow (or raw_all) attribute lists {start, end, value} in €/kWh including VAT, like a Nord Pool template. Leave empty to skip the comparison.
import_entity.title: Import price sensor

spot_decimals.description: The Home Assistant Nord Pool integration rounds the spot price (€/kWh) to this many decimals, the 3 in sensor.nordpool_kwh_ee_eur_3_10_0. EMHASS Lens rounds its own spot price the same way before comparing, so only real differences show. Leave empty when your sensor's source doesn't round.
spot_decimals.title: Spot price decimals in your Nord Pool sensor

tolerance.description: Differences up to this count as equal (templates usually round to 4 decimals).
tolerance.title: Tolerance

PublishedValues.description: The current slot's plan values, EMHASS signs: battery + discharges / − charges, grid + imports / − exports.
PublishedValues.title: PublishedValues

send_p10.description: EMHASS 0.18.4 and later take the pessimistic P10 estimate next to the forecast and blend the two by their own weather_forecast_pv_quantile_bias setting (0 = ignore P10). Not sent while the estimate above is P10 itself.
send_p10.title: Send the P10 estimate too

car_battery_kwh.description: Reserving stops once the energy from the car's level to its target is covered; the rest of the horizon gets the full PV forecast again.
car_battery_kwh.title: Car battery capacity

enabled.description: While the car charges from excess solar (charge mode Excess Solar, plugged in, below the target SoC), the PV forecast sent to EMHASS is reduced by what the charger is expected to take in each slot, so EMHASS does not plan the home battery or exports with energy the car will use. The expected draw follows the Excess Solar rule: the PV forecast minus the house load EMHASS forecasts, in whole amps, capped by the maximum current. Nothing changes in EMHASS or Manual mode.
enabled.title: Reserve PV for Excess Solar charging

Reading.description: One value read from Home Assistant (or a fallback) with where it came from.
Reading.title: Reading

settings_revisions.description: Older versions go only when there are more than this and they are over 30 days old. The current version always stays.
settings_revisions.title: Keep settings versions

path.description: Dotted path of a secret setting, e.g. forecast.ee.api_key
path.title: Path

app_db_max_mb.description: Prices, forecasts, plans, measurements, cost-function plans and settings history. Backed up by Home Assistant. Oldest first too, but never the last days the planner needs.
app_db_max_mb.title: app.db size budget

backup_warn_days.description: Health warns when the newest Home Assistant backup that contains EMHASS Lens is older than this. 0 turns the check off.
backup_warn_days.title: Warn when no backup for

compact.description: VACUUM rebuilds a file without its free pages. It needs free disk space of about the file's size and pauses the App for seconds to tens of seconds.
compact.title: Compact databases

labels.auto: After cleanup, when at least 20 % and 16 MiB are free

runs_db_max_mb.description: Run details and logs. When the data exceeds this, the oldest days go first, whatever the retention below says (pinned runs stay).
runs_db_max_mb.title: runs.db size budget

package.description: Elektrilevi Võrk 1/2/4/5 bring their own network rates; Custom uses the rates below.
package.title: Network package

WearStats.description: Presses of the Sofar apply and feed-in buttons (EEPROM wear), ours and anyone's.
WearStats.title: WearStats
